content.summary: Pure Acoustics AV-105-BT הוא מגבר מולטימדיה שקוע בקיר להשמעת מוזיקה בבית. המוזיקה מגיעה מ-Bluetooth, USB, כרטיס SD, כניסת AUX או רדיו FM, ומתאים למי שרוצה מוזיקת רקע בחדר בלי מערכת גלויה.
goodFor: מוזיקת רקע בחדר, במטבח או בסלון עם רמקולים שקועים
ניגון ישיר ממקל USB או מכרטיס SD בלי טלפון

reviewFlags.issue: Catalog says 40W (20W x 2). The only spec source that gives an output figure (hifitest.de, one foreign review site, not published on its own) says 18.5W RMS. Confirm the rated output with the manufacturer before relying on the catalog figure.

Catalog and Israeli retailers call it an in-wall music amplifier. A manua.ls manual page calls the AV-105 BT a media player with built-in stereo speakers, which conflicts with the amplifier-only description. Check what is in the box and whether speakers are included.

Catalog gives 11.5X7X4.5 cm. The hifitest.de list gives 2.8 x 4.5 x 2.3 inches, in a different order and not convertible under the rules. Dimensions remain unverified and should be measured or checked with the manufacturer.

Manufacturer page (pure-acoustics.com) could not be fetched. Manua.ls writes the model as AV-105BT, and an earlier search snippet said com4tech lists the amplifier under AV-2096 while the fetched page shows AV-105-BT. Verify the model code with the importer.
No Israeli importer or Israeli warranty information was found. Warranty, installation and in-the-box facts are not researched.
Catalog gives 110/220V 50Hz/60Hz. The review source only gives AC 220V 50Hz. Confirm the 110V and 60Hz claims with the manufacturer manual.
Catalog claims MP3, WMA, WAV, MP4 and AVI playback. No authoritative source confirmed this. The manua.ls claim comes from a page that looks machine-generated.
Catalog says 40W (20W x 2); hifitest.de and Flipkart say 18.5W RMS. Confirm the rated output with the manufacturer or importer.
Manua.ls page reportedly describes a media player with built-in speakers, conflicting with the in-wall amplifier description. Check what is in the box.
Catalog gives 110/220V 50/60Hz; source gives only AC 220V 50Hz.
